title: Numbers and phones

num_main_label: Main business line, printed on the door and the website
num_partners_fallback: Falls back to Lena after 30 seconds.
num_salzburg_fallback: Nothing arrives until the carrier connects it.
num_test_fallback: No fallback — used for testing only.
num_whatsapp_label: WhatsApp Business on the main number
num_whatsapp_fallback: Messages queue if the assistant is paused.
porting_title: Porting a number takes days, not minutes
porting_body: Keep the old line active until the port completes. Tel-Agent can answer both numbers meanwhile.
phones_note: Every phone below rings on this line. Extensions are internal — they are not numbers callers can dial.
add_phone_note: Every phone you add rings as an extension on this line. Pick what you are holding.
code_valid: Valid for 10 minutes. Anyone with this code can register a phone on your line.
manual_heading: If the phone cannot scan or auto-provision
kind_desk_step: Plug it in on the business network
kind_desk_body: Switch the phone on and it asks Tel-Agent for its settings. Scan the code with the phone’s camera, or type the pairing code on its keypad — it configures itself and appears in the list within a minute.
kind_dect_step: Register the handset to the base
kind_dect_body: Put the base station into registration mode, then hold the paging key on the handset. Tel-Agent adds it as its own extension so service rooms can be rung directly.
kind_app_body: Install the app from your own server — it is served at /app, no store account needed — and scan this code. The same code works on iOS, Android, macOS, Windows and Linux.
provider_note: Numbers come from a provider you already have an account with. Tel-Agent reads the number and points it here — it never buys one for you.
provider_twilio_note: The only provider wired up so far. Elastic SIP trunking, numbers in most countries, billed by the minute with no contract.
provider_twilio_after: Tel-Agent creates the trunk in your Twilio account and points the number at this installation. Nothing is bought here — the number has to exist in Twilio already.
provider_meta_note: Direct with Meta. You need a Meta business account and a number you can receive a verification code on.
provider_meta_after: Meta verifies the number by SMS or call, then reviews the display name — usually minutes, sometimes a day. Until it is approved the number sits here as Waiting for Meta and messages are not delivered.
field_sid_help: Twilio console, top of the dashboard.
field_token_placeholder: Paste it from the Twilio console
field_token_help: Stored encrypted on this machine and never sent anywhere else.
field_number_help: In international form, exactly as Twilio lists it.
field_region_help: Where the call enters Twilio's network. Frankfurt or Dublin keeps European calls inside Europe.
field_wanumber_help: Must be able to receive one verification code. A landline works if it can take SMS or a call.
field_phoneid_help: Shown next to the number in Meta's API setup.
field_watoken_placeholder: Paste it from Meta Business Suite
field_watoken_help: A system-user token, not a temporary one. Stored encrypted on this machine.
field_display_help: What customers see above the chat. Meta has to approve it and rejects anything misleading.
rings_human: A caller is passed to a human
voice_kind: An ordinary phone number your carrier points at this installation.
whatsapp_kind: WhatsApp runs on a number you own, registered with Meta. It becomes a chat channel, not a phone line.
search_note: Search covers the number itself and the label you gave it.
empty_no_in_body: Nothing here is answering. Check that the SIP account is registered before anything else.
empty_no_out: No number is set up for outgoing calls
empty_no_out_body: The agent can only answer, not call out. Outgoing calls need a carrier that allows them — most Austrian landline tariffs do, but it has to be switched on for the trunk.
empty_no_wa_body: WhatsApp Business runs on a number you already own. Connect it from the Apps page and it appears here alongside the phone line.
nobody_answers: Nothing answers this number yet — calls ring out until you pick someone.
nobody_replies: Nothing replies yet — messages sit unread in Channels until you pick someone.
handset_only: Rings the handsets only. If nobody picks up, the caller hears ringing until they give up.
voicemail_only: Straight to voicemail. Useful for a number you only advertise for messages.
messages_wait: Every message waits for a person in Channels. Nothing is answered automatically.
offline_title: Main number unregistered — callers hear a busy tone
offline_body_after: . Forwarding to a mobile keeps the business reachable while you fix it.
empty_body: Tel-Agent is running but has nothing to answer. Keep the number you already advertise: your carrier points it at this installation, and nothing else about your line changes.
search_note_filtered: Search covers the number and its label, and the “{filter}” filter is narrowing it further.
wa_warning: A number registered for the WhatsApp Business API stops taking ordinary calls and SMS. Use a second number if the one you advertise has to keep ringing.
answers_every_call: {who} answers every call on this number.
replies_every: {who} replies to every message on this number.
order_note: Tried in this order, 20 seconds each: {order}. Change the order later from the number’s row.
order_note_wa: First {first}; anything it cannot settle within five minutes moves to {rest}.
error_body_after: , so Tel-Agent cannot read which numbers belong to this account. Calls on numbers already registered keep working — this page just cannot show the list.
provision_note: A new desk phone gets its settings automatically: scan the code on its screen, or point it at the provisioning URL. The mobile and desktop apps use the same code.
